title: Research construction: exact factor schedules save 26 R420 XORs (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This finite bit-circuit construction reduces **block 7 of the selected PR543 R420 word from 41 to 28 XORs**. Its required literal reverse cleanup saves thirteen more, reducing complete native ADDs **26,916 → 26,890**. **No new κ is claimed.**

An exact subset-state search certifies minima **14 + 14** for the two fixed twelve-wire integer factors, among schedules that finish each destination in one contiguous positive-addition batch. The verifier independently enumerates donor subsets using base-16 integer sums and checks every potential inequality: **8,192 states, 49,152 state/destination pairs, 43,520 feasible transitions**. This is a scoped finite-class optimum, not unrestricted XOR optimality.

The forward integer map is identical and the reverse positive map is entrywise dominated. All arbitrary inputs, per-register frame paths, 420 helpers, nine copies, literal H1–H5 interface and paid rank mass 5,112 are preserved. The reverse prefix falls **2,270,064 → 2,205,308**; the local payload allowance stays 100 bits. Every preparation, read and cleanup is charged. The paid recursive profile and selected κ remain unchanged.

Only `research/r420-block7-exact-schedule/` is added: circuit, complete potentials, independent certificate replay, source pins, proof, native checks, validation and local claim. `upstream/`, selected sources and frontier are unchanged.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r420-block7-exact-schedule/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R420_BLOCK7_EXACT_SCHEDULE factors=17+24->14+14 ADDs=26916->26890 states=8192 columns=660 controls=8 kappa=unchanged`.

- All 4,096 block inputs and 660 dirty-input columns; exact E8/frame checks; eight mathematical/interface/accounting controls.
- Fresh unchanged C++17/Boost legality and **5/9/11-stage** replay on both words: 900/1,380/1,620 columns and **96 bridge-omission controls**. Exact native prefix bills agree with Python.
- Python 3.9.6 and 3.14.5, isolated optimized execution, byte-identical nomination, minimal relocated source tree, source/certificate/receipt corruption and output-preservation controls.
- Selected-record integrity and staged whitespace pass. A committed-files-only export replays and the patch applies cleanly. A bootstrap-created Python cache initially tripped the selected inventory; it was removed and bytecode writes are now suppressed. No selected source bytes changed.

Optional native command: `python3 -I -B research/r420-block7-exact-schedule/native.py --out /absolute/fresh/directory`.

No repository-wide suite, hosted-parent/invoice/outer assembly, selected cold replay, Linux CI, Lean or runtime result is claimed. All-size/compiler/common-label/mutable-basis/hosting/residual/precision/tape/exact-recovery/analytic obligations remain. Finite replay is not a proof of the full multiplication theorem.

## Pins, overlap and attribution

Exact base: **66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60**. PR543: **2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535**; consuming PR626: **660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851**. Git confirms the original word's blob matches PR543. OS-random seed **17**, bit-supplier track, selects block 7. No pinned coordination issue existed; the claim is local.

Credit eumemic's PR543/493, Dylan Crow's exporter/checker lineage, DreamingOfClouds, Zhihao Chen, chafreaky, DaysSky and retained predecessor notices. Concurrent #670/#674 change blocks 3/5, #691 changes quad 13, #681 integrates those circuits, and #754 synthesizes cleanup windows. Refresh through #786 found no block-7/fixed-factor schedule certificate; #774 forests and #782 lattice parity are distinct. No pending implementation is imported or assumed composable. Elementary dynamic programming is not claimed as a new technique.

Prepared by **Yuzhou Wang (@yzhouwang)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in derivation, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. No delegated workers or independent human review.
